newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER SHOWCASE-FACTS AND FIGURES FOR MARSEILLE-AUXERRE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-FACTS AND FIGURES FOR MARSEILLE-AUXERRE.

text.p: Facts and figures for Sunday's French first division match between Marseille and Auxerre at the Velodrome stadium.
Marseille: Founded in 1899 as Olympique de Marseille. They have won the French league title eight times.

Major honours: League champions: 1937, 1948, 1971, 1972, 1989, 1990, 1991, 1992 (also 1993, but stripped of title over match-rigging scandal). French Cup winners: 1924, 1926, 1927, 1935, 1938, 1943, 1969, 1972, 1976, 1989. European Cup: 1993.
Ground: Stade Velodrome, capacity 46,000. Record number of spectators: 48,039 v Ajax Amsterdam, October 20, 1972 in the European Cup.
Trainer: Gerard Gili.
Record league appearances: Roger Scotti 360.

Auxerre: Founded in 1905 as Association de la Jeunesse Auxerroise by the abbot Ernest Deschamps. They have climbed steadily through the ranks of French football, winning promotion to the first division in 1980.
Major honours - League champions: 1996. French Cup winners: 1994, 1996.
Ground: Stade Abbe Deschamps, capacity 22,000. Record number of spectators: 21,226 v Arsenal of England in European Cup Winners' Cup on March 16, 1995.
Trainer: Guy Roux.
Record league appearances: Bruno Martini 322.
Marseille v Auxerre league meetings at Velodrome in last five years: 1-0 (1991/2), 2-0 (1992/3), 0-3 (1993/4). There were no league meetings between the two teams in the last two seasons.
Fascinating facts:
-- Both clubs wear all-white as their first choice colours and all-blue as second choice.
-- Auxerre are commonly referred to in France as l'AJA (the initials of the club's full name), while Marseille are l'OM.

-- Auxerre, promoted in 1980, have been coached by Guy Roux since 1961. They have not finished lower than ninth in the last 10 first division campaigns and only once outside the top 10 in 16 seasons in the top flight. Marseille, 13th in the current first division championship, were never lower than sixth in the eight seasons since 1986 prior to their enforced relegation over the match-rigging scandal.

-- Marseille have not been relegated for strictly playing reasons since 1982. Their relegation in 1994 was ordered by the French league over the Valenciennes match-rigging scandal. They won promotion straight back as 1995 second division champions but were not allowed to benefit from it, being relegated for a second consecutive season for financial irregularities. They finished second in division two last season.

-- The two sides have not met in the league since the 1993-94 season, but they clashed in the semifinals of the French Cup last season. Auxerre eliminated Marseille on penalties and went on to take the Cup for the second time in three seasons.

-- The last league meeting between the two sides was at Auxerre in April 1994. All four scorers in a 2-2 draw, Corentin Martins and Pascal Vahirua for Auxerre, Basile Boli and Anderson for Marseille, have moved to other clubs.
-- Auxerre have played in Europe in 10 of the last 13 seasons, including this one, their first in the European Cup, a French record. In that same period Marseille have played six times in Europe.
